tools.title: Tool Management

webSearch.title: Web Search Configuration
webSearch.description: Site-wide search providers used by every team and agent. Saved keys are encrypted and never displayed.
webSearch.defaultEngineHint: Used when an agent inherits the site default. Only enabled providers can serve searches.
webSearch.defaultEngineDisabled: Enable the provider before selecting it as the default.
webSearch.deepseekKeyHint: Uses the DeepSeek Search API at https://api.deepseek.com/v1/tools/search. Search requests are billed per successful request.
webSearch.searxngBaseUrlHint: Supports a subpath such as /searxng. JSON search must be enabled. Private or internal targets require the site SSRF allowlist; metadata addresses are always blocked.
webSearch.searxngTokenHttpsHint: When a bearer token is set, the base URL must use HTTPS.
webSearch.searxngUrlChangeHint: If you change the instance URL, also enter a replacement token or clear the saved one; a saved token is never sent to a different instance.
webSearch.searxngBaseUrlRequired: Enter the SearXNG base URL before enabling it.
webSearch.searxngTokenConfirmationRequired: The SearXNG URL changed while a saved token exists. Re-enter the token or clear the saved token before saving.
webSearch.keyConfigured: A credential is configured. Enter a new value to replace it.
webSearch.willClear: The saved credential will be removed when you save.
webSearch.newKeyHint: The entered value replaces the saved credential when you save.
webSearch.legacyWarning: Legacy team or agent web search keys were archived and are no longer used. Configure keys here to enable web search.
webSearch.testDescription: Runs a search with the saved site configuration; unsaved changes are not used. Save changes before testing replacements.
webSearch.testQueryPlaceholder: What do you want to search?
webSearch.loadFailed: Failed to load web search configuration.
webSearch.saveFailed: Failed to save web search configuration.

codeEditor.subtitle: Extend AI capabilities with code
codeEditor.parametersHint: Define input parameters for the tool, Agent will call the tool based on this information
codeEditor.pythonPackagesHint: One pinned package per line. Use exact == versions.
codeEditor.jsPackagesHint: One pinned package per line. Use exact package@version entries.
codeEditor.packageSourceUrlHint: Optional. Must be an absolute http(s) URL without embedded credentials. Only affects package installation.
codeEditor.commandHint: Optional. One argument per line. The generated script path is appended automatically.
codeEditor.invalidJsonInput: Test input must be valid JSON
codeEditor.invalidPythonPackage: Python package "{value}" must use an exact == version
codeEditor.invalidJsPackage: JavaScript package "{value}" must use an exact package@version
codeEditor.invalidPackageSourceUrl: Package source URL "{value}" must be an absolute http(s) URL without embedded credentials

error.invalidName: Tool name must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and underscores

mcpCapabilities.title: Client capabilities
mcpCapabilities.hint: Capabilities stay off until explicitly enabled, so the server never receives a claim the product does not honor.
mcpCapabilities.samplingHint: Allow this server to request model completions through the authorized model budget.
mcpCapabilities.elicitationHint: Allow this server to request structured input from the user.
mcpCapabilities.rootsHint: Only these explicitly listed roots are returned to the server. Roots are not a sandbox boundary.
mcpCapabilities.rootsAllowlistHint: One URI or prefix per line. Empty means no roots may be exposed.
mcpCapabilities.elicitationHostsHint: One host per line. URL-mode elicitation is limited to these hosts.
mcpCapabilities.invalidRootUri: Root URI must be an absolute URI without whitespace.
mcpCapabilities.invalidElicitationHost: Enter a bare hostname without scheme, path, port, or wildcard.
mcpCapabilities.rootsRequireAllowlist: Declaring roots requires a roots allowlist.
mcpCapabilities.rootOutsideAllowlist: Every root must be covered by the allowlist.

connections.noConnectionsForMode: No usable connection is configured for this mode.
connections.manageHint: Secrets are encrypted and never shown after saving.
connections.secretFieldsHint: Only the credential fields declared by this tool are accepted.

policy.title: Identity & approval
policy.description: Choose which external account executes this tool and when a person must approve each operation.

hints.none: No connection credentials are accepted or injected.
hints.team_only: Entrypoints use a shared team connection; personal accounts are not used.
hints.personal_only: Every user authorizes their own account. A saved connection is used by anyone who runs the shared agent or workflow.
hints.selectable: The entrypoint must explicitly choose a personal or team connection. There is no automatic fallback.

connectionFields.hint: Declare the credential fields a connection provides. Secret values are encrypted and never returned to the browser.

connectionFields.label: Display label

approval.callerHint: The person triggering the operation confirms it in the current conversation.
approval.userIdsHint: Search team members by name or email.

approval.rolesRequired: Select at least one team role.
approval.noGates: No approval gates configured. A caller confirmation gate is added on save.
